data.one_liner: XPath package for HTML and XML parsing with basic XPath syntax support.
data.what_it_does: Provides an XPath selection mechanism for locating HTML and XML elements. It relies on separate parser implementations such as xpath_selector_html_parser or xpath_selector_xml_parser to process the underlying document structure.
use_when: You need to query HTML or XML documents using XPath expressions.
You want to combine standard XPath syntax with extended CSS-style attribute selectors.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete, out-of-the-box HTML or XML parser package without installing separate parser dependencies.
You only need basic tree traversal without XPath expression capabilities.
strengths: Supports basic XPath syntax and advanced CSS-style attribute selectors.
Decoupled from specific parsers, allowing custom node implementations.
weaknesses: Requires additional parser packages (like xpath_selector_html_parser or xpath_selector_xml_parser) to parse documents.
Not all advanced XPath features are supported.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a compatible parser package like xpath_selector_html_parser or xpath_selector_xml_parser alongside this library.

alternatives.name: xml
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want built-in XML parsing and querying without needing a separate XPath selection wrapper.

data.minimal_example: // This library is for xpath selection only, you must define a parser like xpath_selector_html_parser or xpath_selector_xml_parser.
